name: io.github.zerotaldev/paystack
title: Paystack
description: Create and verify Paystack payments across Africa. Test mode enforced by key prefix.

environmentVariables.name: PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Paystack secret key. The sk_test_ or sk_live_ prefix sets the mode.

environmentVariables.name: PAYSTACK_ALLOW_LIVE
environmentVariables.description: Required only with an sk_live_ key. Must be 'i-understand-this-moves-real-money'.

environmentVariables.name: PAYSTACK_MAX_AMOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling on a single transaction, in major units
